releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.5 — groups and forwarding. Forward any message: the long-press menu now has Forward, which opens the reference picker (search, multi-select chats, gradient 'Forward to N' action) and delivers the message into each chat with a Forwarded label. Group conversations now behave like group chats: sender names sit above incoming bubbles, the header shows the member count and tapping it opens Group Info — rounded group avatar with camera badge, editable name, description, mute switch, the member list with Add members, and Leave group with confirmation. Newly created groups appear in the chat list too, so you can message them straight away.
